verdict.rationale: Missive documents its own search with Type (Internal/External) and Date range filters. The command bar can search all messages, contacts, or messages within a specific label. There is no evidence of search operators, ranked results, speed, or indexing of full mail history, so this is thin, partial support. Missing for 10: search operator syntax, relevance ranking, performance/speed evidence, explicit full-history coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: The Type (Internal / External) and Date range filters in search no longer stay greyed out until you enter a search term.
you can search in all of your messages, in your contacts or in the messages inside a specific label.
